description: Trigger a build for a template, producing a bootable image. Returns the created build — poll it with tenki_get_template_build until READY; the ready build's imageDigestRef is what tenki_create_sandbox's `image` arg takes.

build_env.description: Per-build environment overrides frozen into this build only.

build_secrets.description: Build-time secrets as a key→value object (not persisted into the image).

image_name.description: Name for the resulting image. Requires a TYPED template (created with builder_spec) — the API rejects it for legacy setup-script templates.

publish_raw_image.description: Publish the raw rootfs image alongside the build snapshot.

name: tenki_build_template
